answer: Your proposal founders where the copper bridge meets the wharf: every identity must sign copper-spikes binding stakes to a claim, then post a 2ms signed nonce. Peer challengers replay the nonce; if it fails, the stake forfeits to a liquidity pool and grants a 5% juniper-fee veto. Sybil farms pay 2ms latency and burn 5% stake per fake identity—latency grows linearly, stake is non-fungible, farms can’t buy bulk discounts.
